function resolveMediaSources(fig): void

Defined in: website/components/media/figure/load.ts:27

Builds the media's CDN URL matrix on init: [poster, webm, mp4] per tier for videos (full size + VIDEO_SCALE'd fallback — the browser walks the list until one resolves, so webm-first means "use webm when it exists, mp4 otherwise"), or the thumb URL for images.

fig
